task: ae.png strict PNG codec: five scanline filters, adaptive encoder, strict chunk/CRC/zlib decoder, ImageIO differential and CRC-resealed corruption tests
reasoning_summary: Designed Png record, PngFilter, PngEncoder and a strict PngDecoder around java.util.zip. Tests: hand-computed filter literals, round trips over every colour type/depth/filter mode, differential tests against javax.imageio in both directions, CRC-resealed crafted images per structural rule with controls, and flip-every-byte/truncation loops. A mutation pass over 18 rules left three survivors (signed score, filter-type boundary message, interlace message) that were closed with targeted tests.
